purpose: Convert the already measured same-engine buy_hold benchmark semantics into a named production-capable cash-long ownership mode because the fixed 199-case campaign-peak matrix shows that, under the user's current return-first priority, active turnover destroys more secular compounding than it creates across the three frozen core scopes.

known_retrospective_basis.interpretation: These economics are already observed and motivate implementation. The new production-mode replay is not an unseen experiment; it must reproduce the existing benchmark exactly before any promotion claim.

production_semantics.capital: Split original initial cash equally across the supplied universe once. Each security owns its original sleeve budget; unused budget is not reassigned to another name.
production_semantics.admission: For each supplied symbol, spend its remaining original sleeve at the earliest next-open execution opportunity allowed by the existing engine. Missing/pre-IPO quotes, opening limits, insufficient prior-only capacity, board-lot constraints and affordability may delay or partially fill ownership; residual sleeve budget remains available for later retries.
production_semantics.holding: After actual purchase, never voluntarily sell, trim, rebalance or restore equal weights. Capital gains compound in place. No score, trend, sector, risk-state or future outcome controls membership.
production_semantics.execution: Use the unchanged engine next-session clock, cash conservation, commission, slippage, board-lot, raw-price equivalent, opening-limit, prior-volume capacity and ordinary 1%-NAV executable materiality rules.
production_semantics.causality: No pre-2023 observations, future prices, future availability or terminal membership outcomes are inputs. Prefix replays must match the full snapshot exactly through the cut date.
production_semantics.removal: Removing a supplied security removes both its signals and its original capital sleeve; no historical PnL or unused budget is transferred into remaining names.

implementation.reuse: Do not approximate benchmark behavior in an external Owner. Refactor the existing engine buy_hold state machine only enough that research benchmark='buy_hold' and production strategy='passive_ownership' execute the same shared path byte-for-behavior.
implementation.conflicts: strategy='passive_ownership' is mutually exclusive with benchmark, external targets and policy_factory.
implementation.metadata: Research buy_hold keeps benchmark='buy_hold'. Production passive ownership records strategy='passive_ownership' and benchmark=null without changing accounting or execution semantics.

tdd: production passive ownership and research buy_hold have identical daily equity, targets and complete order ledger on the same market/config/cost/delay
prefix replay is exactly equal through the cut date
late-listed security retains its own original cash sleeve and does not cause earlier purchases or capital transfer
blocked or partial initial purchase retries without selling existing inventory
passive ownership rejects conflicting benchmark, external target or policy_factory inputs

economic_screen.benchmark_equivalence: Treatment must exactly equal benchmark='buy_hold' account outputs on every measured scope before economics are interpreted.
economic_screen.advance: Under the user's return-first authorization, require treatment mean(log terminal wealth) to exceed campaign-peak control and treatment minimum terminal wealth to be no lower. No MDD/order gate is used for this alpha-first promotion screen, but all risk and turnover metrics remain reported.
economic_screen.full_history: If the fixed screen advances, measure the same source through all 896 frozen sessions and the frozen bull/late-June-August/July-August/recovery windows without reselection.

final_validation.formal: Prove production passive ownership equals the already measured same-engine buy_hold comparator across the fixed 199-case formal plan or rerun only where exact evidence equivalence cannot be established.
final_validation.references: Native-reference common-five comparison remains native/not-equivalent-execution. Normalized/equivalent-execution reference superiority remains separately required if the original final contract demands it.
final_validation.risk: Return-first promotion does not imply superior risk control. Drawdown, stress, timing and execution limitations must remain explicit.

prohibitions: No stop/reentry rule in this family
No changing costs, delays, data, universe or metric definitions to improve the result
No claiming the already observed benchmark economics are prospective or unseen
No deleting failed active research or invalid provenance evidence
